After a [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|mercenary group]] interrupted a [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|meeting]] between [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Spynet]], the Alliance wished to locate the aggressors responsible for the attack. Using intelligence gained from a [[Unidentified mercenary (Falcon's Nest mercenaries)|mercenary]] captured in the battle, the Alliance launched an unofficial investigation to '''locate the mercenary base'''. Alliance leadership contacted the civilian [[Aeron Azzameen]] and her brother [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], a decorated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], to conduct the reconnaissance. The [[Azzameen family|Azzameens]] agreed and left in their ship, the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', to investigate the captured mercenary's lead: the [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser]] ''[[Redhawk]]'', moored at the shipping [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Cargo Station]]''.

The ''Otana'' arrived and Aeron began [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. Finding a set of coordinates, the Azzameen left the system and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] toward the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} saved coordinates. However, the coordinates had been falsified, and the ''Otana'' exited hyperspace in an Imperial weapons testing facility in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] during a live-fire test. The family [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] scrambled to calculate an escape route as Ace maneuvered the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] out of the path of incoming [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire. Eventually, a set of return coordinates was found, and the Azzameens returned to ''Cargo Station''. There, they found that the ''Redhawk'' had left, but determined the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser's]] destination by slicing into the station's records. With these new coordinates, the ''Otana'' once again entered hyperspace, this time en route to the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} destination.

[[File:Thrawn_fleet_XwA.jpg|thumb|200px|"[[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|Thrawn's fleet]]" in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]
Upon arrival, the Azzameens were shocked to find that the ''Redhawk'' had led them to their home, [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]]. The station, which had been renamed Falcon's Nest, had been previously [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|captured]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after a series of altercations between the family and their Imperial-aligned rivals [[Viraxo Industries]] before being turned over to the mercenary group that currently occupied it. Though Ace wished to engage the mercenaries, the others aboard the ''Otana'' convinced the pilot to instead return to the Alliance [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], where a proper attack could be planned. Shortly after returning with this information, the Alliance, along with the Azzameen family, launched an [[Battle of Azzameen Station|attack]] against Falcon's Nest which saw the defeat of the mercenary group as well as the return of the station to the Azzameens.
